== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Anakin Skywalker, Jedi Knight (Holo AI) (Errata)]]: the image of [[Anakin Skywalker, Jedi Knight (Holo AI)]] (published 11 November 2021, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/db69e725e1573252cbb01232d9d6622b26c16dea/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/anakinskywalkerjediknightholo_ai.png holotable db69e72]) and the image of [[Anakin Skywalker, Jedi Knight (Holo AI) (Errata)]] (published 26 January 2025, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1bbafcff4f1010e91306c29c21b72ad10518c00e/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/anakinskywalkerjediknightholo_ai.png holotable 1bbafcf]). Same area (x 583–723, y 990–1039) cropped from each published image; pixels unchanged; top: before, bottom: after. Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
